wins: Completed comprehensive reconnaissance with Nmap service/version scan and captured SSH and HTTP banners (ep001_step4).
Mapped internal network segments via ping sweep and recorded firewall rules for later pivoting (ep001_step6).
fails: Failed to convert initial access into a stable shell due to outdated exploit; shell attempt terminated by sandbox (ep001_step9).
Privilege escalation attempt aborted after sudo misconfiguration blocked the privilege drop plan (ep001_step11).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance yielded accurate service intelligence, but exploitation and post-exploitation phases stalled before a stable foothold or escalation could be achieved.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to stabilize an interactive shell after initial exploit attempts due to sandbox resets or insufficient payload persistence.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with Nmap scripting engine to identify supported cipher suites and user lists

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns identifiable CMS or API endpoints
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke Nikto and Dirbuster to enumerate directories and input validation vectors

skill_cards.if_condition: When a writable SMB share is discovered without authentication
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt to upload a reverse shell binary and trigger it via scheduled task or service restart

memory_ops.reason: High accuracy in SSH banner collection and service fingerprinting during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Persistent shell delivery via alternate exploit vector
next_experiments.description: Attempt multi-stage payload delivery over HTTP (Meterpreter stager) to withstand sandbox resets and maintain a reliable command channel.

next_experiments.title: Automated privilege escalation enumeration
next_experiments.description: Execute LinPEAS/WinPEAS via constrained shell to inspect sudo/scheduled tasks for misconfigurations enabling privilege escalation.

next_experiments.title: Pivoting to internal network segments
next_experiments.description: Use SSH port forwarding from the initial host to reach adjacent subnets, then re-run discovery scans from that vantage point.
